# EasyDB

> EasyDB is a serverless edge REST API with three capabilities: NoSQL (schemaless JSON documents), SQL (relational tables) and object storage (files and media), hosted at https://easy-db.cloud. No SDK is needed: use plain HTTPS. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer edb_live_...` (registered, via GitHub sign-in) or `x-tenant-id: demo_store` (shared public sandbox: 100 documents, 5 files, small SQL quota).

Important: update replaces the whole document (no merge); find has no filters; API keys can only be created by a human in a browser.

## For AI coding agents

- [SKILL.md](https://easy-db.cloud/SKILL.md): Complete agent guide: auth, all endpoints with examples, quotas, errors and pitfalls. Read this first.
- [Agent resources page](https://easy-db.cloud/agents): Human-friendly page to view, copy and download these files.

## Docs

- [Homepage and live playground](https://easy-db.cloud): Try the API in the browser with the sandbox.
- [Pricing and quotas](https://easy-db.cloud/pricing): Free, Developer and Scale plan limits.

## Optional

- [Sign in with GitHub](https://easy-db.cloud/api/v1/auth/github/login): Creates a tenant and shows the API key once.
